issue_context.title: Kubelet: cpuset `Builder.Result` method does not behave as documented
issue_context.body:
(Apologies for only vaguely following the template, I found this problem using static analysis, not while actually running Kubernetes.)

**What happened**:

The receiver variable `b` of the [Builder.Result](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1220a8ae92c20f6ae1a0929e4f32c2f513bf82ca/pkg/kubelet/cm/cpuset/cpuset.go#L58) method in `pkg/kubelet/cm/cpuset/cpuset.go` has type `Builder`, not `*Builder`, so its receiver gets passed in by value, not by reference. Consequently, the assignment `b.done = true` is useless.

**What you expected to happen**:

The method documentation says that calling `Add` after `Result` has no effect, presumably since `Add` checks `done` and returns immediately if it is true.

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:

Here is a reproduction in the Go playground: https://play.golang.org/p/TZ6h0DKBluR

I've copied in the relevant type and method definitions at the top, the `main` function at the bottom shows that invoking `Add` after `Result` does, in fact, have an effect, in spite of what the documentation says.
